title: Colleagues' grandparents were UFO report people on the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote:
there are some people I'm uh colleagues
with that like their grandparents were
actually you know the UFO report people
on the Manhattan Project

plain: A former US intelligence officer named David Grusch says some of his colleagues have told him that their grandparents were the people who handled UFO reports during the Manhattan Project, the secret US effort of the 1940s to build the atomic bomb. If true, it would mean UFO reports were being quietly gathered inside one of the government's most secret projects, long before most people had heard of flying saucers.
